title: Ladybug
description: Brings back vanilla bugs in a elegant way
body:
This plugin currently adds 2 items, the bedrock breaker, and the update suppressor

The bedrock breaker is a rechargable item crafted with a TNT, a piston, and an obsidian (from top to bottom) and can be recharged with TNT in anvils. Clicking on the **top** face of blocks will vanish them, just like the headless piston bug does. Each uses decrease the durability by 10, it can be used 19 times before another recharge is needed

The update suppressor is crafted from a sea lantern in the middle, 4 netherite ingots on the sides, and 4 nether stars in the corners. Placing it down will pause all block updates within a 128 blocks range. Right clicking on it can toggle it on/off, breaking it with any tool will drop itself
